entries.rationale: The complete researcher-supplied catalogue verifies the exact title, author order and contributor roles, DOI, ISBNs, complete availability, and the actual 169-entry catalogue structure. It corrects provisional repository metadata without changing the work identity.

before.container_title: Magical and Religious Literature of Late Antiquity 7

before.notes: Repository metadata states 177 entries: bowls/fragments plus two skulls, one bone fragment, and one eggshell. Accepted manuscript is restricted.

Aramaic Magic Bowls in the Vorderasiatisches Museum in Berlin: Descriptive List and Edition of Selected Texts. Magical and Religious Literature of Late Antiquity 7. Leiden and Boston: Brill, 2018.
after.notes: Complete 254-page researcher-supplied catalogue held in the private archive, SHA-256 7a25b7b89f8160aaec249988f47a5fb08b654c8ca9506b44fcc48ee60cde6aac. It has 169 numbered catalogue entries, not 177. Entry 168 contains fragments from at least two distinct bowls; the selected-text section treats seventeen physical items in sixteen sections. Copyrighted text and images are not cleared for public release.
